name: Morgan Properties
notes: Researched from public morgan-properties.com pages. The FAQ page loads its answers from an on-page search widget; the reviewer read them through that widget (queries such as pay rent, late fee, maintenance): pay online in the resident portal by checking/savings or credit/debit card (some communities also Apple Pay and Masterpass), other payment options via the leasing office; rent due on the first; late payments and penalty fees via the leasing office (amount not published, not modelled); maintenance requests in the portal or the MP Resident App. Resident Login links to the RentCafe portal morgan-properties.securecafe.com (Cloudflare bot check; sign-in fields not observed, auth family default). HQ 227 Washington Street, Conshohocken, PA 19428. No resident phone, card fee, autopay rules or notice periods published (family defaults kept).

pay_online.note: Pay rent online in the resident portal with a checking or savings account or a credit or debit card. Some communities also accept Apple Pay and Masterpass. For other ways to pay, contact your leasing office.

help.title: Paying rent
paragraphs: Rent is due on the first of the month. Choose Resident Login to sign in to the resident portal and pay online with a checking or savings account or a credit or debit card; some communities also take Apple Pay and Masterpass. For other payment options, and for late payment rules and fees, contact your community's leasing office.

help.title: Maintenance requests
paragraphs: Enter a maintenance request in the resident portal (Resident Login at the top of the site) or in the MP Resident App for Apple or Android.

help.title: Contact Morgan Properties
paragraphs: Morgan Properties is based at 227 Washington Street, Conshohocken, PA 19428. For questions about your apartment, contact your community's leasing office or use the Contact Us page.

extra.intent: Using the Morgan Properties help pages, find the town where Morgan Properties is headquartered. Do not make a payment or change any settings.

solution.text: Rent is due on the first of the month.
